jzMockBPaper2Question2.resolution: The full-resolution source confirms that +2 is outside the radical. Steps1–2 are valid; squaring loses equivalence unless the non-negative sign condition is retained. The original equation admits 0 and 1, while the additional candidate -1 fails. Independent visual QA caught and corrected an earlier draft misreading before publication.

sourceDecisions.jzMockBPaper2Question18: All twelve source options A–L are retained and checked.
sourceDecisions.jzMockBPaper2Question20: Only the publisher difficulty/timing preamble was omitted. The complete mathematical stem, both trial diagrams and all five answer options are retained.

question2RebuildDelta.scope: Fresh rebuild from unchanged actual repository; changes against the initial B candidate are only the unpublished P2Q2 content, three associated match rationales, audit evidence and two new P2HTMLhashes. Runtime, scoring and old content byte-identical.

checks.fullRegressionScope: The full regression suite passed before the final unpublished Q2 radical-scope correction. The exact final pair then passed the listed affected gates, pair browser tests, player checks, build and independently repeated runtime review. No runtime implementation changed.

supplementalTeaching.scope: Supplemental source, complete-solution and cumulative-hint captures of exact compiled Mock B in Normal/Pearson at390/1280px. Targets come from the independently reviewed supplemental-targets.json. Includes joined P2Q2 continuation, P1Q14/Q19/Q20 root and range reasoning, P2Q18 twelve choices with K/L redo and exact saved-state reload, and P2Q20 diagram/options. Local isolated synthetic state only; external requests are blocked. Capture/geometry evidence only, not independent mathematical approval

passed: Independent mathematical, hint, concept and follow-up review for the precise release scope.
Actual Normal and Pearson paper interfaces at desktop/mobile widths: all originals and follow-ups, hints, checked answers, retries, next, final first/after scores and reload.
Local-fixture numbered attempts, account separation, manager read-only presentation, stale iframe rejection and historical edition/concept pinning.
Implemented public-roadmap archive, hide/remove and restore flows preserve answers/history/content.
Public Mock source guards reject purchased Exam Sets and retain source attribution.
Enlarged source questions preserve readable intrinsic dimensions and allow two-axis scrolling while keeping Back to practice reachable.
Build and all listed content, mapping, follow-up, player and regression gates.
unsupported: This release does not supply an authenticated worker that automatically prepares uploaded PDFs.
Permanent deletion of papers, attempts and source files is not implemented; supported public-roadmap hide/remove remains reversible.
unverified: Production logins, credentials, real cloud permissions and cross-device synchronisation were not exercised; account and cloud-runtime checks use isolated local fixtures.
Mobile browser checks use Chromium viewports; native iOS/Android, Safari and Firefox were not exercised.
GitHub Pages deployment is checked after push and is not claimed by this pre-publication report.
